senses.gloss:
नैवि(बि)ड्यम्
—1 Compactness, closeness, thickness, denseness.
—2 Substance.
—3 A continuous sound.
नैवेद्यम् An offering of eatables presented to a deity or idol.

—1 Any vessel or implement forming part of domestic furniture; नैवेशिकं
 सर्वगुणोपपन्नं ददाति वै यस्तु नरो द्विजाय Mb. 13. 57. 33.
—2 A present to a Brāhmaṇa householder, e. g. a girl or ornaments
 given with her.
